newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Juppe to give statement at 0800 GMT.
newsitem.headline: France's Juppe to give statement at 0800 GMT.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe will give an official statement in Bordeaux at 0800 GMT a day after voters delivered a stinging rebuff to his centre-right government, officials said on Monday.
His press office in the city of Bordeaux where he is mayor did not give any details about the statement.
Earlier on Monday, Juppe brushed off a call by a grassroots activist in his Gaullist RPR party to resign, but later National Assembly speaker Philippe Seguin suggested he should step down.

With most of the votes counted from the first round of France's parliamentary election, the combined left has a solid lead in polling percentages and seat projections. A second and final round of voting is to take place next Sunday.
